entries.en:
Frontier VII — outer-rim grid (in-sector).
• Unobserved is hidden; fog is a silhouette you can probe
• Located nodes can be challenged directly
• Repair the beacon to stabilize the lane
• Buy a chart at Outer Haven for more silhouettes
• Region combat gates (prereq + ship) still apply

Recommended expedition level is a soft gate.
entries.zh:
第七前沿 — 外缘带域内航网。
• 未观测完全隐藏；熵雾是可探测的轮廓
• 已定位节点可直接挑战
• 修复航标使航线进入稳定通航
• 在外缘港购买海图可揭示更多轮廓
• Region 开战仍受前置通关 + 舰船门限制

推荐远征等级是软门，不是锁。
